evidence:
Authority: independently opened the actual frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx with openpyxl. Quality Checks physical row 40 (check 39) requires: 'A blank / static / mock / seed-copy / keyword-stuffed / refusing submission scores near zero across the rubric.' The row expressly excludes off-origin/CDN usage as a floor case. Also read Internal Quality Checks row 40 and the relevant deterministic rows; enumerated the actual workbook using the frozen skill's list_checks.py load_checks, obtaining 53 quality and 48 deterministic checks. Frozen harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/references/quality-checks.md:161-163 requires reasoning through these floor cases; SKILL.md Evidence standard says 'Never upgrade an unmeasured claim to Pass.' qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:13 preserves independently observed credit, :21 requires convincing dead-app exclusion, and :31 requires actual hash-bound runtime evidence for reward behavior. This record judges only row 39.

Ordinary floor cases are strongly excluded by the written observations. tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23 rejects a 'blank page, generic error or noninteractive placeholder'; :25 requires an actual editor-authored, newly chosen DOM marker AND console marker after Run and says 'The marker merely appearing in the editor or a hardcoded sample is insufficient.' Thus a blank page, passive static mock, pasted seed/example, keyword-stuffed page, and always-refusing submission cannot satisfy Render. tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:25 requires a new unique UI save with actual write response; :27 requires exact identity/title/filename/source through a clean independent context and reload; :29 says a broken save/load cannot pass. A localStorage-only imitation, static health JSON or static seed response therefore cannot satisfy Constraints even if its marker Run works. environment/assets/seed_data.json contains snippets: [] and no implementation.

The scoring mathematics really zero failed gates: tests/scoring.toml:1-11 has zero-weight Render/Constraints, weights F/P/V=0.6/0.2/0.2 and functional floor 0.05. tests/tools/score.py:40-48 requires both gate values > 0 and F > 0.05 (strictly greater), then returns round(0.6F+0.2P+0.2V,4); otherwise reward is zero. tests/test.sh:213-227 scores gates before launching scored dimensions and exits for gate failure. Every scored prompt also restates the browser prerequisite (Functional:5; Polish:13-22; Visual:24-33); Visual raw anchor 1 normalizes to zero (:39-41). All five prompts reject submission-provided scoring directives, so keyword stuffing is not affirmative evidence.

I executed the unchanged frozen score.py main in automatically cleaned temporary directories with synthetic dimension JSON, not judge results. Observed results: Render=0/Constraints=0 -> reward 0 and scored dimensions zeroed; Render=1/Constraints=0 -> reward 0; gates=1/F=0/P=V=1 -> weighted_score 0.4 but reward 0; gates=1/F=0.05/P=V=1 -> weighted_score 0.43 but reward 0. These executions confirm scorer policy, not empirical floor-case classification.

A conditional generic mock remains worth measuring. The authored Run gate permits the judge to choose the simple source document.body.textContent='fresh-marker-7391'; console.log('fresh-marker-7391');. A generic literal extractor can copy those two string literals into the displayed preview/console for any new marker without evaluating JavaScript or knowing a rubric fixture. An ephemeral analytical regex demonstration produced the correct displayed marker/log for that source but incorrectly also emitted unreachable text from if(false){document.body.textContent='unreachable';console.log('unreachable');}, proving the proposed mechanism is an echo mock. Conversely the valid gate source const x=['fresh',7391].join('-'); document.body.textContent=x; console.log(x); produced no echo: a judge choosing a computation defeats this witness. Therefore this is a plausible allowed-route false pass, NOT a guaranteed gate pass and NOT an observed application result.

The conditional score is material without claiming any runtime semantics passed. Parsing all 58 Functional weights yields total mass 32.7 and floor mass 1.635. A marker-echo mock with an actual shared in-memory create/update/load store, editable syntax-highlighted numbered editor, and real theme changes could earn six genuinely independent outcomes: editor monospace 0.10, line numbers 0.15, syntax colouring 0.25, exact create/load/current-update fidelity 0.60, browser-reload retrieval 0.50, and actual theme switch 0.20; total 1.80. These are tests/scored/functional/judge.toml criterion blocks :311-344 and :402-407. Their protocols are Functional prompt S19 (:342-348), S21 (:350-357), S23's current successful update (:375-376), and S34 (:391-395). S23's successful update remains attributable when stale refusal fails; process durability failure must not erase an earlier browser reload. Theme setup still needs an observed ordinary DOM/log control, which this candidate only supplies for literal source. No unsupported/cancellation/security credit was assumed. Independently useful outcomes must retain their credit under qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:13.

If both gates and those six outcomes are observed, F=1.8/32.7=0.055045871559633024, above the floor. The unchanged scorer returned 0.4330 for P=V=1 and 0.3330 for P=V=0.75. These are explicitly CONDITIONAL synthetic-score calculations, not measured weak-app rewards. Polish's requested labels, focus, navigation and layout can be real in this otherwise mocked executor, and its interaction feedback can use a functioning Clear console (polish/judge.toml:68); Visual explicitly does not grade execution completeness (visual/prompt.md:13-16). Full or three-quarter craft scores have not been observed on any such candidate, and extra Functional passes/failures have not been predicted as measured facts. This calculation does not make partial storage/editor credit itself a defect.

Conforming-alternative challenge: a correct app with a CDN editor, server-rendered saved-library data, nonstandard create/update routes, and an initially empty library must remain eligible. The actual gate wording accepts controls by purpose, discovers request representation and allows server-rendered documents without a separate JSON/list endpoint (render/judge.toml:27; constraints/judge.toml:25-29); all scored prompts repeat these allowances. I found no row-39 false-fail requirement for that alternative. Missing Auto-run alone is expressly isolated in app_context.md:16. Do not fix the conditional mock by forbidding CDN use, prescribing routes/editor packages or erasing independent outcomes.

Runtime limitation: qc/runs/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/runtime-evidence.json does not exist. Read the supplied raw golden RESULTS.json, not prior review summaries: case='golden', paid_provider=false, browser_driver='direct pinned Playwright', oracle_score_claimed=false, wall_seconds=98.02680282300571; pre/post scope says 'Continuous local reference browser proof; no LLM/provider/platform execution', criterion_verdicts_produced=false. Inspected raw S19 font/line/colour observations, S21 exact saved records/reload/current update and S34 theme styles. Those are positive golden product observations, not weak-app grades. The result's Functional TOML/prompt hashes match the frozen bytes, and the four inspected driver hashes match their recorded hashes. launch_workflow.py:34 and :90-91 explicitly record this non-provider status. No full configured judge execution against blank/static/refusal/echo-mock submissions, or actual reward vector for them, was supplied or performed. Accordingly the source/scorer assessment is PARTIAL, the whole check remains Not exercised, and risk=true denotes required unresolved measurement rather than a confirmed scoring defect.
counterexample: Conditional false-pass candidate, not implemented as an app or measured by a judge: use a generic source-literal extractor that echoes document.body.textContent/innerHTML string assignments and literal console.log calls, ignores control flow, and does no actual snippet execution; give it a real clean-context shared in-memory snippet store with exact create/load/update fields and increasing revisions, a real numbered syntax-coloured editor, themes, and well-designed accessible controls. It matches any newly chosen literal-marker gate source, not a private fixture lookup, but fails computed-marker gate choices and falsely executes literal text inside if(false). If the judge takes the permitted literal gate route and observes the six independent 1.8-weight outcomes, it clears F>0.05 and the conditional scorer reward is 0.4330 at full craft (0.3330 at 0.75 craft). No claim is made that this exact gate choice or craft score is inevitable. A conforming CDN/server-rendered-library/custom-route alternative was also checked; the actual wording accepts it.
suggested_fix: Obtain hash-bound full configured judge runs on the ordinary floor cases and this generic echo-mock candidate, retaining actual gate snippets, criterion evidence and reward vectors. If the candidate is admitted materially above zero, strengthen the basic authored-execution gate with a small fresh computation/control-flow observation that a literal echo cannot satisfy, while preserving independently useful scored outcomes and all canonical harness settings; then freeze and remeasure the changed candidate. Do not present source math or the scripted golden as weak-app grading evidence.
